scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship For Students With Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular full‑time student.
Applicant must have an admission or unconditional offer for Master’s or Ph.D. programmes abroad in institutions/universities accredited by the host country’s government or authorized body.
Disability percentage must be at least 40%.
benefits_summary: Grants comprehensive financial support including annual maintenance, contingency, equipment, tuition, visa, medical insurance, travel allowances, and air passage for eligible disabled students pursuing Masters or PhD abroad.
